easyPrerequisites:
Traveling Minister does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Traveling Minister.
description:
Activate Traveling Minister by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's ability by paying {U}, untapping Traveling Minister.
Repeat.
